name: crystal-ball-themes
description: Swap themed video sets on a USB 'electronic crystal ball' display (ArtInChip EVDO-M4) without touching its firmware.
author: JP Caparas <jp@jpcaparas.com>

scripts.setup: npm run themes && npm run doctor
scripts.lint: uvx ruff@0.16.10 check && find src tools test -name "*.js" -o -name "*.mjs" | xargs -n1 node --check
scripts.test:tools: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt python tools/smoke_test.py
scripts.themes: npm run themes:halloween && npm run themes:monsters -- --skip-missing && npm run themes:fortunes -- --skip-missing && npm run themes:spirit -- --skip-missing && npm run themes:seance -- --skip-missing && npm run themes:parade -- --skip-missing
scripts.themes:halloween: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt python tools/make_halloween.py assets/themes/halloween
scripts.themes:monsters: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt python tools/voice_theme.py tools/scripts/monster-parade.json
scripts.themes:fortunes: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt python tools/voice_theme.py tools/scripts/fortune-teller.json
scripts.themes:spirit: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt python tools/spirit_theme.py tools/scripts/spirit-in-the-ball.json
scripts.themes:seance: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt python tools/spirit_theme.py tools/scripts/midnight-seance.json
scripts.themes:parade: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt python tools/spirit_theme.py tools/scripts/hollow-hill-parade.json
scripts.icon: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt python tools/make_icon.py assets/icon
scripts.install-app: npm run package && mkdir -p "$HOME/Applications" && rm -rf "$HOME/Applications/Crystal Ball Themes.app" && ditto "dist/Crystal Ball Themes-darwin-$(node -p process.arch)/Crystal Ball Themes.app" "$HOME/Applications/Crystal Ball Themes.app"
